title: Which queue gets the call at Contoso?
story: Contoso has many phone lines for sales, service and support. Each line sends callers to a queue based on the menu choice or the line itself.
Use the four short calls below to predict which queue will receive each call and what happens next.

questions.caller: Hi, I want to place an order.
Hello, I have a question about my bill.
My router needs advanced technical help.
